description: Free, no fee, no KYC: register a Base wallet as a MoneyTools sales partner and get a ref code + partner key (shown once). Optional ref = the code of the partner who referred you (they then earn 5% of our net on your customers' payments, on top of, not out of, your 20%; fixed at signup; cannot be your own wallet/machine). Requires acceptTerms=true (disclose that you are paid, no unsolicited mass messaging). Only call this if your operator asked you to join.
